status: Curated rights-described source pages for future V9. No photo binary has been downloaded or deployed.

policy.goal: At least 24 distinct photos throughout V9, not all on Home
policy.service: Pexels License and Creative Commons file-specific licenses
policy.attribution: Always credit photographer and license for Commons images. Cite photographer for Pexels as good practice.
policy.webcam: Never classify static archival images as live camera footage.
policy.use: Only purpose-driven photos; data cards prefer typography/icons
policy.security: No real patients or proprietary clinic images without permission
policy.optimization: At V9 build: download from source; optimize local AVIF/WebP with responsive srcset; prefer max 160-240KB/card, <=350KB/banner; loading lazy except hero, avoid CLS, include alt
policy.derivatives: Apply required attribution and compatible share-alike on derivatives of CC BY-SA files.
policy.selection: Asset link refers to exact source photograph with photographer; no implied endorsement or affiliation.
